description.value: Castella Cheesecake is a Japanese-style specialty pastry bakery chain founded in Vancouver in 2018, celebrated for its hand-crafted Basque 'Burnt' Cheesecakes, Japanese Soufflés, and Molten Cheese Tarts made without heavy industrial machinery. The Richmond Centre location is one of several Metro Vancouver outposts of the brand, situated inside the mall on Level 0. A touring cyclist passing through Richmond could stop here for a distinctive Japanese-inspired dessert treat.
